title: Broker or dealer involvement
description: Declares whether any broker or dealer was involved in the movement, and their details. isPresent gates the items array: when true at least one entry is required, when false or absent entries are forbidden.

items.description: Not allowed when isPresent is false or absent.

isPresent.description: Whether a broker or dealer was involved in arranging the movement. Absent is equivalent to false.

items.description: The brokers or dealers involved. Required with at least one entry when isPresent is true, and must not be provided otherwise. More than one may be declared.
